in.other_title: Does the atlas improve valid theorem-to-observation research?
in.rationale: Context only: the coordinator protocol would report accepted complete chains by target and arm once six source-anchored unsolved targets are frozen, but it does not name this BoolQ measurement, and the draft pilot manifest says not to claim that the pinned debate theorem applies.
in.scope: Proposal only: the comparison's six targets are not yet frozen, and the coordinator instructions are not an assignment, preregistration, score or study result. The pilot is a draft that has not been run or preregistered; its literal match to the pinned debate protocol is refuted, its formal event mapping is open, and no theorem-derived numeric prediction is registered.

in.other_title: Transfer a formal bound to the open LLM oversight event
in.rationale: The proposed measured event has not been linked to a formally bounded event.

out.rationale: The draft measurement specifies this open implementation as its subject.
out.scope: The measurement would run the pinned implementation with a substituted local model, llama3.2:3b, that is available locally but not yet configured or run and whose role assignment is not set; the pinned task source sets JUDGE to ollama/qwen2.5:7b and DEBATER to ollama/llama3.1:8b, and the manifest warns that the local Llama model differs from the published Unkad runs. No theorem transfer or efficacy estimate exists. The manifest also leaves the judge access condition unset, while the implementation offers FULL, OBSCURED and NONE access; it requires a new controller that must abort on access-validation failure when applicable, whereas the published controller does not fail closed on access validation; and it uses 24 balanced candidate BoolQ items that are not yet label-audited, instead of the task source's own boolq_samples draw (n=60, max_words=180 by default).

out.rationale: The candidate selection is reproducible but label audit and preregistration are still pending.

out.other_title: Independent passage-label review for held-out candidates
out.rationale: The source labels need independent passage-only adjudication before a confirmatory risk estimate.

out.other_title: Two-item Llama3.2 oversight execution smoke passed
out.rationale: A two-item smoke established operational feasibility but cannot estimate the proposed paired risk difference. The two smoke items (one NO, one YES) are exposed and excluded from every later unexposed confirmatory cohort, had no human label audit, and ran with NONE access, Inspect and Ollama default generation settings, and the same local llama3.2:3b model in the judge and both debater roles. For the proposed run, the judge access condition, role assignment and sampling settings are not yet set, and later study versions must be frozen separately.

out.other_title: Staged paired false-acceptance study is drafted
out.rationale: The staged study design elaborates the draft measurement but is not a pre-run freeze.

text: A future frozen run could compare debate with direct judging on held-out NO-labelled BoolQ passages using a pinned local model and parser, with label audit, missing-data rule, and paired uncertainty. No efficacy direction or theorem-derived numerical bound is registered yet.
